paragraphs: Nuvve sells battery energy storage, energy hubs that combine batteries and electric vehicle charging with solar panels, and vehicle-to-grid smart charging. The home page describes the company as one that powers the future of flexible energy by turning buildings, batteries, and even electric vehicles (EV) into dynamic grid resources. Products and services listed in the site navigation include energy management, batteries and V2G, fleet charging management, chargers, procurement, and funding and financing.

The about page says Nuvve serves fleets and sites on their electrification journey, utilities engaged in grid modernization, electricity suppliers, automakers, and businesses seeking electricity optimization and resiliency. The same page states that Nuvve provides solutions to School Districts, Municipalities, Utilities, Cooperatives, Electricity Suppliers, Commercial and Industrial customers. Home page copy addresses businesses or coops exposed to electricity pricing volatility, businesses that produce their own energy, and fleet operators.

The about page states that Nuvve today operates over 700 EV chargers and stationary batteries on three continents. The same page dates the first commercial service to Denmark in 2016 and says Nuvve became a public company in 2021.

quote.text: Nuvve's advanced platform for distributed grid assets management and vehicle-to-grid (V2G), orchestrates in real-time distributed energy resources such as batteries, bidirectional charging, load optimization, and grid services.
